msg: Hola, buen día. Somos un grupo de 7 amigas de Bogotá. Tres ya tenemos el Open Water, dos quieren probar el minicurso y dos prefieren snorkel. ¿Cuánto saldría por persona saliendo desde Cartagena y hay descuento por grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Buen día! ¡Qué chévere plan para las siete! Sí, pueden combinar buceo certificado, minicurso y snorkel en la misma salida; según la operación, podrían ir juntas en la lancha o dividirse por actividad.

Te dejo a continuación los precios por persona saliendo desde Cartagena. Para el grupo de 7 aplica un 10% de descuento de grupo en buceo recreativo, minicurso y snorkel; hay que solicitarlo al equipo antes de pagar. Además, el descuento online se suma al de grupo.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

¿Quieres que te ayude a continuar con la reserva?

msg: Hello. My wife and I arrive on a cruise ship in Cartagena on March 3rd, docking at 7:00 am and we must be back on board by 5:00 pm. We would both like to snorkel. Is that doable? We are from Canada.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The snorkeling trip is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands, but the standard schedule is too tight for your cruise timing: departure is at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita, and the boat returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. That leaves only about 45 minutes before you need to be back on board, and the trip doesn’t include transportation to the cruise terminal.

A team advisor would need to review whether an adjustment is possible. Would you like me to connect you with one?

🤿 *Snorkeling Tour*
💰 *126 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, activity insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided sessions with a local guide, snorkeling equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

Going from the islands wouldn’t work for your cruise schedule either: snorkeling there ends around **12:00–1:00 p.m.**, but you’d return to your hotel on the islands—not to Cartagena. Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

msg: Hi, we're two Dutch divers, both Rescue Divers, in Cartagena from the 10th to the 16th. We bring our own full gear. We want to dive on three separate days from Cartagena, coming back to the city each night. What's the best price for us?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! From Cartagena, the regular Fun Dives trip includes two dives in one day and returns to the city the same day, so it fits your plan to come back each night. For three separate dive days, you’d book that trip on each day.

Your complete own gear qualifies for the 5% equipment discount on recreational diving, and it can be combined with the online discount. I’m leaving the per-person prices below; the exact total for all three days will be shown during booking.

msg: Solo yo. ¿A qué hora me recogerían en el Cocoliso y tengo que llevar algo? Gracias.
reply:
En Cocoliso te recogerían entre las 9:30 y las 9:45, y regresarías al hotel hacia las 12:00–13:00. La recogida y el regreso están incluidos.

Lleva bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo está incluido. También debes presentar tu carné de buceo; puedes mostrarlo el día de la actividad o enviar una foto antes. 🐠

También necesitas:
• Estar listo a las 9:30 en tu hotel
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

¿Han pasado *más de 2 años* desde tu última inmersión?

msg: Thanks. Our 11-year-old has never dived, he isn't certified. And our daughter is the 7-year-old: so is there really nothing she can do? We can't leave her behind, so would she just stay on the boat while the rest of us are in the water?
reply:
Your 11-year-old doesn’t need certification for the **Dive Mini Course**—it’s available from age 10 and includes pool practice and an ocean dive with an instructor. Your 7-year-old can join the **snorkeling tour** (available from age 6), so she doesn’t have to stay on the boat. Minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult.

For those who haven't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.

- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). - If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. - Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. - Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. - If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.

- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.

- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. - If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.

- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.

msg: Thank you. What exactly does the refresher consist of? I would prefer to do proper dives on Wednesday: could I do a short review with the guide in the morning and then the 2 dives on the same day? I could also come on Tuesday if necessary.
reply:
The refresher includes a pool session with theory and confined-water practice, followed by one reef dive with a PADI instructor. It takes the full day, so you can’t do the refresher and the two-dive trip on the same day.

Since you haven’t dived for three years, the refresher is normally required. You could do it on Tuesday and the two dives on Wednesday. The refresher meets at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and returns to Cartagena at about 4:15 p.m. It includes the boat, equipment, lunch, insurance, and park entrance fee. After your last dive on Wednesday, wait at least 18 hours before flying; a 10:00 p.m. Thursday flight meets that interval if your last dive ends by 4:00 a.m. Thursday.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

Question: What is the Rescue Diver course and why is it important?
Other ways to ask: What does the Rescue Diver course involve and what are its benefits? / Why is it relevant to take the Rescue Diver course?
Answer: Rescue Diver is an advanced recreational course focused on prevention, emergency management, and diver rescue. To take this course, you need to have Advanced Open Water certification and recent EFR or first-aid training. The course covers self-rescue techniques, stress recognition, panic management, missing diver search, rescue scenarios, and emergency response. It is more mentally demanding than physically demanding, and many divers consider it transformative because it shifts the diver's mindset toward safety, awareness, leadership, and prevention. It does not grant a professional level; the first professional level is Divemaster.

msg: Buenas tardes. Somos 6 amigos de Bogotá, todos certificados, y queremos hacer dos días de buceo saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Tienen descuento de grupo? Dos de nosotros llevamos nuestro equipo completo: ¿hay descuento por eso y se suma al de grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Qué buen plan para disfrutar dos días de buceo en las Islas del Rosario. Para dos días desde Cartagena, pueden elegir entre el paquete de **4 inmersiones diurnas** o el de **5 inmersiones, que incluye una nocturna**.

Sí, por ser 6 tienen **10% de descuento de grupo**, que se suma al **10% online**. Deben solicitar el descuento de grupo al equipo **antes de pagar**; no se aplica automáticamente. El precio online del paquete de 4 inmersiones es **USD 316 / COP 1.154.000 por persona** y el de 5 inmersiones es **USD 392 / COP 1.429.000 por persona**. Como son de Bogotá, pagan en COP.

El **5% por equipo propio** aplica solo a quienes llevan el equipo completo, pero **no se suma al descuento de grupo**: cada descuento se combina únicamente con el online.

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

¿Cuál de los dos paquetes les interesa?

msg: Muy claro, gracias. Preferiríamos dormir en Cartagena: ¿podemos hacer dos salidas de un día, ida y vuelta cada día, en vez del paquete? ¿Cuánto saldría por persona con el descuento de grupo? Y para los dos que llevamos equipo, ¿qué nos conviene más?
reply:
Sí, pueden hacer dos salidas de un día, cada una con ida y vuelta a Cartagena. Hay que solicitarlo al equipo antes de pagar. No calculo el total con descuentos; el equipo les confirma el valor final al cerrar la reserva.

Les conviene comparar ambas opciones con el equipo al cerrar la reserva.

La salida es a las 8:00 a. m. desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita y el regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p. m. (llegada aproximada a las 4:15 p. m.).

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *630.000 COP* por persona · 6 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

⚠️ Si alguno lleva *más de 2 años* sin bucear, se añade el *refresher* (el minicurso: piscina y una inmersión con instructor): *655.000 COP* por persona. ¿Es el caso de alguno de ustedes?

msg: Hey! I'm an American diver, Advanced Open Water. I'm renting a house on Airbnb on Isla Grande next week, it's called Villa Marea. I'd like to do two dives. Can you pick me up there? How does that work?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Great that you're staying on Isla Grande — you're right in the heart of the Rosario Islands, and the diving there is beautiful. 🤿

About pick-up: since you're staying in a house/Airbnb (Villa Marea) and not at one of the hotels on our list, an advisor needs to confirm the pick-up logistics with you **before** you book and pay. If the house has maritime access, the boat can often come directly; if not, we'll point you to the nearest dock or meeting point. Pick-up and drop-off by boat are included at no extra charge when you're already on the islands.

For two dives from the islands, the plan is **Fun Dives – 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)**:
- 124 USD / 440.000 COP online (138 USD / 489.000 COP regular)
- Certification required (Advanced Open Water is perfect)
- Gear included, lunch not included
- Hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m., 2 open-water dives with a surface interval at our base, and back at your place around 12:00–1:00 p.m.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor so they can confirm the pick-up at Villa Marea? Once that's confirmed, you'd be able to complete the booking.

msg: Buenas tardes. Mi esposa y yo venimos de Medellín a Cartagena de luna de miel y nos gustaría probar el buceo. Nunca lo hemos hecho y nos da un poquito de nervios. ¿Cuánto cuesta y qué incluye? Nos estamos quedando en Bocagrande.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué bonito plan para su luna de miel! Es muy normal sentir un poquito de nervios al empezar; el minicurso incluye entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor PADI acompañándolos durante todo el proceso.

Incluye transporte en lancha Cartagena–Islas del Rosario–Cartagena, entrada al Parque Nacional Natural, seguro obligatorio de buceo, equipo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. No incluye el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas ni comida adicional.

La salida es desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a. m.; desde Cartagena no hay recogida en el hotel, así que tendrían que llegar por su cuenta. El regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p. m., con llegada estimada a las 4:15 p. m. El minicurso es una experiencia de iniciación, no una certificación.

Te dejo también el precio del snorkel a continuación, por si quieren comparar opciones.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

Para una primera vez te recomiendo el *minicurso*: teoría, práctica en aguas tranquilas y una inmersión en el mar con instructor, sin necesidad de experiencia. Si lo que buscas es certificarte, está el *curso PADI Open Water*. ¿Te animas con el minicurso? 🤿

msg: Gracias. Nos interesa el minicurso, para los dos. ¿A qué profundidad se baja? Y mi esposa pregunta si hace falta saber nadar muy bien, porque ella nada lo justo. Quisiéramos ir el sábado 14 de noviembre.
reply:
El minicurso baja hasta 12 metros; lo habitual es estar entre 5 y 12 metros. No hace falta experiencia previa, pero no tengo confirmado si se requiere saber nadar o qué nivel de natación se necesita. Como tu esposa nada lo justo, es mejor que un asesor confirme ese requisito antes de reservar.

También necesitas:
• No hay teoría que hacer antes: se hace allí, el mismo día, con el instructor.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 12 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

🤿 *Minicurso de Buceo*
💰 *655.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

¿Quieren que les pase con un asesor para reservar y coordinar el pago? 🌊

msg: Hey! Planning a bachelor party in Cartagena in February, there will be 6 of us from Texas. Three of the guys are certified and three have never dived. We want one day out on the water together. The three who haven’t dived before can choose a Dive Mini Course, snorkeling, or come along as companions. The mini-course is introductory, not a certification, so it’s a separate activity from the certified dives.

I’m leaving the prices below. Your group qualifies for the 10% group discount on eligible activities, on top of the online discount. It must be requested before paying, and it isn’t applied automatically.

• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like help choosing the activities for the other three?

msg: Good call on asking: one of the certified guys, Mike, last dived about three years ago. The other two dived last summer. No beers, got it. So what does Mike need to do? And who do I talk to on your team to get the group discount before we pay?
reply:
Since Mike last dived about three years ago, he’ll normally need a refresher before joining the certified dives. It’s a pool session and one dive with an instructor, and it takes a separate day—he can’t do the refresher and the dive trip on the same day. If he has already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts. Very experienced divers with 500+ dives or Dive Master level can be reviewed by a team advisor.

To request the group discount, contact our team before paying. The 10% group discount applies to groups of 5 or more and stacks with the 10% online discount; it applies to both recreational diving and mini-courses. It isn’t automatic, and it can’t be added after payment. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor?

You'll also need:
• There is no theory to do beforehand: it is done there, on the day, with the instructor.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying

Keep in mind that the mini-course is a one-day introduction and does not certify you; to get certified there is the Open Water course (2 days, with a night on the islands).

msg: Good afternoon. My name is Anna, I am from Germany. I will stay at the Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande from November 20 to 24. Good afternoon, Anna! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands’ reefs. Since San Pedro de Majagua is one of our base hotels, pick-up and return by boat are included at no extra charge. For daytime dives, pick-up is around 9:30–9:45 a.m., and you’ll return to your hotel around 12:00–1:00 p.m.; lunch isn’t included for island-based plans.

For two days of diving, the 4-dive package includes two daytime dives each day. I’m leaving the prices below.

• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD

• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like to book that option?

msg: Hiya! I'm Priya, a British backpacker on a tight budget, currently in Santa Marta and heading to Cartagena next week. I've got three free days, November 17 to 19, and I've always wanted to get my diving certification. Is that doable in three days, and what's the cheapest way of doing it? I've got a hostel in Getsemaní booked already.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That’s a lovely goal, Priya! Yes, you can complete the PADI Open Water course within your three free days. It takes two days, but you’ll need to stay overnight on the Rosario Islands between them; your Getsemaní hostel won’t cover that, and island accommodation isn’t included.

The course includes online theory, pool training and four certification dives. From Cartagena, you meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. on day one and return around 4:15 p.m. on day two. I’m leaving the course prices below. The online rate is the cheapest listed option; you can book through the official link: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• PADI Basic Course (Open Water): 693 USD · 770 USD

Would you like help checking what to consider for arranging your overnight stay on the islands?

msg: Just me. Okay, I'll start from Cartagena then. What should I bring with me for the two days? I only have my big backpack, can I take it on the boat or leave it somewhere? I'd also love to bring my GoPro. And can I pay in cash when I arrive? My UK card charges me a fee abroad.
reply:
For the two days, bring a swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving gear is included. You can bring one backpack or bag on the boat; if it’s a suitcase, it needs to be arranged with the team. You can also leave a suitcase at our Cartagena office. There are lockers at our island base for your smaller belongings while you dive.

I don’t have specific information about bringing a GoPro, so I can’t confirm that detail.

As an international guest, payment is 100% by card through the website when you book; cash payment on arrival isn’t available. I understand the foreign-card fee is frustrating.

You'll also need:
• With this plan you must stay at least 1 night on the Rosario Islands (hotel not included)
• The theory is done through PADI eLearning (approx. 10 to 12 hours). You must complete it before starting the practical phase.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.

🤿 *PADI Basic Course (Open Water)*
💰 *693 USD* per person (online rate)
📚 PADI course: dates, sessions and details are arranged with you.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: Okay, thanks. So who can tell me about the GoPro? I'd really like to film my first dives, it's kind of the whole point for me. And is storing my backpack at your office free? Last thing: I've got a flight to Medellín on the 19th at 9 in the morning, is that fine if I finish the course on the 18th?
reply:
You can bring your GoPro on the dives, at your own risk. We don’t rent cameras. Underwater photos and videos aren’t included, but an instructor may take some as a voluntary gesture; any tip for that is optional. Since filming is important to you, I can’t promise the instructor will be able to film your dives.

You can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If you’d rather leave it at our Cartagena office, I don’t have the storage fee details handy, so I can’t confirm whether it’s free.

You can fly from **7:00 a.m. on the 19th** after daytime dives on the 18th, so your **9:00 a.m. flight meets the 18-hour waiting period**. The waiting time is counted from your last dive, not from when you return to Cartagena.

The group discount and the own-equipment discount do NOT stack with each other: each one stacks only with the online discount.
Currency: Colombians (wherever they live) and residents of Colombia pay in COP and everyone else in USD; it is the same price in both currencies. Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.

¡Hola! Sí puedes bucear con nosotros, pero como llevas unos 4 años sin bucear, normalmente primero necesitas hacer un refresher. Es el minicurso de buceo: práctica en piscina y una inmersión con instructor, y ocupa un día; ese mismo día no se hace la salida de dos inmersiones.

El refresher cuesta **655.000 COP online** e incluye lancha ida y vuelta desde Cartagena y almuerzo. Si ya hiciste un refresher o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, puedes ir directamente a la salida. ¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para coordinarlo para el fin de semana?

msg: ¿Me tocaría hacer algún repaso antes? ¿En qué consiste y cuánto cuesta en pesos?
reply:
Sí, con más de 2 años sin bucear normalmente toca hacer un repaso antes. Es el refresher, que se reserva como el Minicurso de Buceo: no hay teoría previa, se hace allí mismo el mismo día con el instructor, y consiste en práctica en piscina más una inmersión con instructor. Ocupa su propio día, así que ese día no se hace la salida de buceo; si vienes varios días, lo ideal es hacer el refresher el primero y bucear los demás. 🐠

Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, eso cuenta y puedes bucear directo. Y como es un minicurso, se requiere el formulario médico de curso, aunque ya seas buzo certificado.

Te dejo los precios por persona a continuación. 👇

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP

¿Para cuántas personas sería: solo para ti o van más? 😊

msg: Me alojo en el centro histórico. ¿A qué hora y dónde hay que estar, y qué incluye el precio?
reply:
El punto de encuentro es a las 8:00 a. m. en el Muelle de la Bodeguita, a unos 5 minutos del centro histórico. Cada persona llega por su cuenta; el transporte hasta el muelle no está incluido. El regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p. m., con llegada estimada a las 4:15 p. m.

Como llevas unos 4 años sin bucear, el repaso se hace como refresher: incluye entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor PADI. También incluye la entrada al Parque Nacional Natural, seguro obligatorio de buceo, lancha ida y vuelta, equipo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. No incluye transporte terrestre al muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas voluntarias, comida adicional ni regreso en otra fecha.

También incluye:
• 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado

El *refresher* es un repaso con instructor antes de volver a bucear: se reserva como *Minicurso de Buceo* y cuesta *655.000 COP* por persona que lo necesite. Lleva el formulario médico de curso (aunque estén certificados, el enlace llega con la reserva). ¿Te interesa?

msg: Our flight home leaves at 7:00 AM the day after we dive. Is that okay?
reply:
For certified divers, the minimum wait before flying is **18 hours after your last dive**, counted from the last dive itself (not from the return to Cartagena). With a daytime dive, activities end around 12:00–1:00 p.m., so you can fly from **7:00 a.m. the next day** — your 7:00 a.m. flight the day after diving fits perfectly. ✈️

One thing to keep in mind: a flight on the *same* day as the dive never works, whatever the time. But diving the day before and flying at 7:00 a.m. the next morning is fine.

Shall we go for the *2-dive trip*, a *multi-day package* or an *advanced course*? 🌊

reply:
Yes, pick-up and return by boat at Cocoliso are included at no extra charge. The usual pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m.; the exact meeting point is coordinated based on the hotel’s boat access. Diving gear is included, so you don’t need to bring your own. Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes.

You'll also need:
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.

The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.

msg: Hi, I'm a German traveler in Cartagena and I've never dived. I'd like to get my Open Water certification. How long does the course take?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Open Water course takes **2 days** and certifies you to dive down to **18 m**. It’s a great way to start diving!

From Cartagena, Day 1 starts at **8:00 a.m.** at Muelle de la Bodeguita and includes pool training and two dives. You’ll stay overnight on the islands (accommodation isn’t included). Day 2 includes another pool session and two final dives, with the boat returning to Cartagena at **3:00 p.m.** (around **4:15 p.m.** arrival). The course also has **PADI eLearning theory before Day 1**.

The online price is **USD 693 per person**; the regular price is **USD 770 per person**. Would you like the booking link?

msg: ¿Ella puede hacer algo en el agua? ¿Y necesitaría algún permiso médico?
reply:
Sí, puede hacer snorkel en superficie, con el visto bueno de su médico. Durante el embarazo no se recomienda bucear con botella.

Para el snorkel, el contexto no indica que necesite un formulario médico; sí debe contar con la aprobación de su médico. 🪸

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.

¿Te animas con la *salida de 2 inmersiones*, un *paquete de varios días* o un *curso avanzado*? 🌊

msg: Do I need a refresher since it's been so long? And how do I book?
reply:
Yes — since it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It's the mini course: pool session plus one ocean dive with an instructor, and it takes its own day, so it can't be done the same day as the dive trip. If you'd already done a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, that would count and you could dive directly.

It includes the park entrance, dive insurance, boat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena, the pool training + 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor, equipment and lunch. msg: Mi madre es vegetariana y tiene 68 años. ¿Hay almuerzo para ella y algún problema por la edad? ¿Se puede llevar una maleta o bebidas alcohólicas?
reply:

En la lancha pueden llevar una mochila o un bolso por persona. Si necesitan llevar una maleta, hay que coordinarlo con un asesor; también pueden dejarla en nuestra oficina de Cartagena. No se permite llevar ni consumir bebidas alcohólicas en la lancha ni durante la actividad, y tampoco consumir alcohol antes de bucear.

msg: Un detalle: mi esposo buceó por última vez en abril de 2022 y yo en enero de este año, en Capurganá. ¿Eso cambia algo para él?
reply:
Sí, para tu esposo normalmente se requiere un *refresher*, porque han pasado más de 2 años desde su última inmersión. Es el minicurso con práctica en piscina y una inmersión con instructor, y ocupa un día completo; ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Como estarán varios días, puede hacer el refresher el primer día y bucear los demás. Si ya hizo un refresher o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta y puede bucear directamente. Para buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones o nivel Dive Master), el equipo evalúa si hace falta.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Ser buzo certificado y presentar tu carnet

Para quien aún no ha elegido te recomiendo estas opciones. ¿Cuál le apetece más? 🐠
• *Minicurso de buceo* — Primera vez bajo el agua con instructor: entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión real. Sin experiencia previa.
• *Curso Open Water* — Curso de certificación inicial: habilita para bucear de forma autónoma hasta 18 m.
• *Snorkel* — Para disfrutar el arrecife desde la superficie, con máscara y aletas. Ideal en familia.
• *Buceo certificado* — Inmersiones guiadas para buzos ya certificados; para explorar el arrecife a profundidad.
• *Ir de acompañante* — Viene en la lancha y disfruta el día con el grupo, sin meterse al agua.

msg: ¿Qué incluye cada salida? Queremos saber si hay que llevar almuerzo y si el transporte hasta el muelle corre por nuestra cuenta.
reply:
Para el buceo certificado, cada salida incluye la entrada al Parque Nacional, seguro de buceo, lancha rápida Cartagena–Islas–Cartagena, dos inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI, equipo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. No necesitan llevar almuerzo; si requieren comida adicional, esa sí corre por cuenta de ustedes.

El transporte terrestre hasta el muelle no está incluido: cada persona llega por su cuenta al Muelle de la Bodeguita, a las 8:00 a. m. La lancha regresa a las 3:00 p. m., con llegada estimada a Cartagena a las 4:15 p. m.

Como tu esposo lleva más de dos años sin bucear, para él corresponde un refresher, que incluye entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor. También incluye almuerzo y el transporte en lancha; el transporte terrestre al muelle corre por cuenta de ustedes.

• *Buceo certificado* — Inmersiones guiadas para buzos ya certificados; para explorar el arrecife a profundidad.

msg: Listo. Somos colombianos los dos y saldríamos desde Cartagena el sábado 21 y el domingo 22. ¿Cómo hacemos para reservar y pagar? ¿Se puede dejar un anticipo?
reply:
Sí, pueden dejar un anticipo del 50 % y pagar el otro 50 % el día de la actividad, con tarjeta o efectivo. Como son colombianos, la reserva se cierra por este chat con un asesor, quien les envía el enlace, el QR o Llave para pagar. También pueden pagar el 100 % en línea. El precio es el mismo en pesos colombianos; no hay descuento especial por ser colombianos.

Siempre hay disponibilidad: operamos todos los días, festivos incluidos, salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero; si el mar no está apto, la salida se reprograma.

El *refresher* es un repaso con instructor antes de volver a bucear: se reserva como *Minicurso de Buceo* y cuesta *655.000 COP* por persona que lo necesite. Lleva el formulario médico de curso (aunque estén certificados, el enlace llega con la reserva). ¿Les interesa?

msg: My husband is a certified Advanced diver (his last dive was in Cozumel this past March). Our daughter is 11 and has never tried scuba, and our son is 6. I don't dive. What could each of us do?
reply:
That sounds like a lovely family plan! Since you’re staying at Cocoliso on Isla Grande:

- Your husband can join certified fun dives; with Advanced certification, his maximum depth is 30 m.
- Your 11-year-old can try the Dive Mini Course, available from age 10.
- Your 6-year-old can join the snorkeling tour, available from age 6.
- You can join the snorkeling tour too, or enjoy the boat as a non-diving companion.

Minors must be accompanied by a parent or responsible relative. 🌊

Which one are you leaning toward — *diving*, a *mini-course*, *snorkeling* or a *PADI course*? 🌊

msg: ¿Los niños pueden bucear con esas edades? Al de 9 le encanta el mar, pero no sé si es muy chico para el minicurso.
reply:
¡Sí, pueden disfrutar del mar! Con 9 años, puede hacer *snorkel* (desde los 6) o *Bubble Makers*, una experiencia introductoria en piscina o aguas muy poco profundas, máximo 2 m, con instructor dedicado. El minicurso es desde los 10 años, así que todavía es muy chico para esa actividad.

Con 13 años puede hacer *snorkel*, el *minicurso* o cursos PADI, incluido *Open Water*, *Advanced* y *Rescue*. Para las salidas como buzo certificado necesita tener certificación Open Water. Los menores deben ir acompañados por un adulto responsable.

Si quieres, te ayudo a reservar: *Minicurso de buceo*. ¿Te animas? 🌊

msg: ¿Cómo es el curso Open Water con ustedes? ¿Cuántos días dura, hay que estudiar algo antes y se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día?
reply:
¡Es una experiencia buenísima para empezar a bucear! El Open Water dura **2 días** e incluye entrenamiento en piscina y **4 inmersiones en aguas abiertas**.

Antes de la parte práctica debes completar la teoría en **PADI eLearning**, que toma aproximadamente **10 a 12 horas**. El curso requiere alojarse **al menos una noche en las islas**: no se puede ir y volver a Cartagena ambos días. El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel.

Saliendo desde Cartagena, el primer día la lancha sale del Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a. m.; haces piscina y dos inmersiones, y luego vas al hotel en las islas. El segundo día completas la piscina y las dos inmersiones finales, y regresas a Cartagena en la lancha de las 3:00 p. m. (llegada aproximada a las 4:15 p. m.). El almuerzo está incluido el primer día, no el segundo.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan exacto. 🌊

msg: ¿Tenemos que dormir en las islas? ¿Qué incluye y qué no incluye cada plan, por ejemplo el hotel y las comidas?
reply:
Sí, para completar tu *Curso Referido Open Water* deben dormir al menos una noche en las islas. El día 1 no se regresa a Cartagena; el alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel.

El curso incluye:
• Ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural Corales del Rosario, seguro de buceo obligatorio y transporte marítimo ida y regreso Cartagena-Islas.
• 4 inmersiones de certificación con instructor PADI, equipo completo y certificación PADI.
• Intervalos de superficie en instalaciones del hotel, almuerzo el primer día y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.

No incluye el hotel, el transporte terrestre al muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas voluntarias, comida adicional diferente al almuerzo incluido ni otros servicios no especificados. El almuerzo del segundo día tampoco está incluido.

• *Buceo certificado* — Inmersiones guiadas para buzos ya certificados; para explorar el arrecife a profundidad.
• *Snorkel* — Para disfrutar el arrecife desde la superficie, con máscara y aletas. Ideal en familia.
• *Ir de acompañante* — Viene en la lancha y disfruta el día con el grupo, sin meterse al agua.
